proved_sufficient_state: r + current local endpoint coordinates (a,b) + one signed residual z + sector mod 6 + phase bit; O is carried only for endpoint projection/translation

observations.residual_register: z is sufficient to choose the next edge by a single sign test and finite-difference update
observations.information_theoretic_note: on reachable states z is a deterministic polynomial slack function of r,a,b,phase, so removing z is mathematically possible if one recomputes the frozen support polynomial at each turn
observations.firewall_note: that recomputation would reintroduce the support/Q-style oracle forbidden as the target runtime route; under the frozen runtime firewall the explicit residual is the smallest currently proved sufficient online register design
observations.sector_phase: sector and L/R phase are finite control, not radius-growing memory
